description: This file declares the VssDatabase class, which implements the IVssDatabase interface. It manages a VSS (Vehicle Service Specification) database, providing methods for path validation, metadata management, and signal handling within a vehicle or similar system. The file also includes necessary headers, class dependencies, and licensing information.

classes.name: VssDatabase
classes.description: Implementation of the IVssDatabase interface that provides management and access functions for a VSS data store, including metadata and signal handling.

methods.name: pathExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific path exists in the database.

methods.name: pathIsWritable
methods.description: Determines if a specific path is writable.

methods.name: pathIsReadable
methods.description: Determines if a specific path is readable.

methods.name: pathIsAttributable
methods.description: Checks if a specific path can have attributes assigned.

methods.name: getDatatypeForPath
methods.description: Retrieves the datatype associated with a specific path.

methods.name: getLeafPaths
methods.description: Returns a list of leaf paths under the specified path.

methods.name: checkAndSanitizeType
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes the JSON metadata and value according to type.

methods.name: initJsonTree
methods.description: Initializes the JSON tree from a file.

methods.name: checkPathValid
methods.description: Validates whether a given path is valid within the system.

methods.name: isActor
methods.description: Determines if a JSON element represents an Actor.

methods.name: isSensor
methods.description: Determines if a JSON element represents a Sensor.

methods.name: isAttribute
methods.description: Determines if a JSON element is an Attribute.

methods.name: updateJsonTree
methods.description: Updates the JSON tree with data from another JSON structure or channel.

methods.name: updateMetaData
methods.description: Updates metadata for a specific channel and path.

methods.name: getMetaData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a given path.

methods.name: setSignal
methods.description: Sets a signal value at a specific path and attribute.

methods.name: getSignal
methods.description: Retrieves a signal value at a specific path and attribute.

methods.name: applyDefaultValues
methods.description: Applies default values to a JSON tree based on the current path.

methods.name: checkArrayType
methods.description: Validates or adjusts the type of an array within JSON data.
